content: Telegram scheduling pitfalls: 1) Timezone confusion - server timezone ≠ user timezone. Collect timezone on registration. 2) Over-scheduling - more posts ≠ more engagement; 1-3/day max for operational bots. 3) Missing unsubscribe mechanism - users block instead of opt out, increasing complaint rate. 4) Batch sending with 5-10 second intervals reduces anti-spam risk. 5) Monitor block rate per segment after broadcasts.
